newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 11.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Qatar's Emir Sheikh Hamad says will discuss with U.S. President Clinton disputes in the region.
- International banks offer loans worth $828 million to finance a Moroccan power project.
- Strike at Kuwait's airport costs Kuwait Airways one million dinars a day.
- A four-member summit of Egyptian, Jordanian, Palestinian presidents and Israeli prime minister is expected soon.
- Iran sends military support to its borders as the Turkish army approaches Iran territories.
- Saudi Aramco raises its oil exports to China and discusses the setting up of refineries.
- Saudi Al-Zamil group to set up with a U.S. company a plant for chemical additives with investments of 110 million riyals.
